page_title: HAM 0-0 MON | Hamburger SV v B. Monchengladbach 17/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90+5' B. Monchengladbach have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+4' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) makes a rough challenge and Robert Schroder blows his whistle for a foul.
90+3' Great teamplay by B. Monchengladbach as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
90+2' The referee allows time for a substitution. Haris Tabakovic will be replaced by Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach).
90+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Hamburger SV.
90' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Problems for Eugen Polanski as Kevin Diks is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Kota Takai (B. Monchengladbach) replaces him.
86' The attendance for today's match is 57000.
85' Merlin Polzin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Guilherme Ramos (Hamburger) replacing Bakery Jatta.
84' Fouls committed – 14:15.
80' Jordan Torunarigha (Hamburger) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alexander Rossing-Lelesiit (Hamburger) comes onto the pitch so that Jean-Luc Dompe can be given a rest.
80' Merlin Polzin has decided to substitute Damion Downs and he is replaced by Robert Glatzel (Hamburger).
79' B. Monchengladbach try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.
79' It looks like Damion Downs (Hamburger) saw red with that tackle. Robert Schroder won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. B. Monchengladbach have a free kick.
76' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.
75' B. Monchengladbach take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
73' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

73' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence. The linesman makes the right call and B. Monchengladbach will have a corner.
72' The B. Monchengladbach players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
69' Substitution. Florian Neuhaus is replaced by Giovanni Reyna (B. Monchengladbach).
69' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Franck Honorat.

69' A great touch by Miro Muheim (Hamburger)! He latched on to a perfect cross and ripped a long-range shot that flew straight to the middle of the net. Not a big deal for the goalkeeper as he made an easy save.
67' Merlin Polzin is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Nicolas Capaldo suffers an injury and Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger) comes on.
67' Today's match ends for Ransford Konigsdorffer who will be replaced by Rayan Philippe (Hamburger).
66' Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
65' Flag up against Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
64' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
61' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
60' Hamburger SV have been awarded an indirect free kick.
59' Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent.
58' What a save from Moritz Nicolas! Damion Downs (Hamburger) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
56' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Miro Muheim (Hamburger), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
56' Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Hamburger SV have a free kick.
55' Good defending. Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) tries to find Haris Tabakovic inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
54' The total number of attempts is 18:2.
51' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Robert Schroder saw the whole situation.
50' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
48' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) passes the ball onto Franck Honorat, but one of the defenders dispossesses him. It's a throw-in for B. Monchengladbach.
47' Jordan Torunarigha (Hamburger) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' Robert Schroder has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

44' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) skips past the defender inside the box and blasts the ball at goal, but sends the effort high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
44' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
42' Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
41' Robert Schroder blows for a foul after Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
39' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) sends it out of play. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.

38' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Corner kick. B. Monchengladbach will have an opportunity.
37' Bakery Jatta (Hamburger) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.

36' Nicolai Remberg (Hamburger) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
34' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sends a long cross over to Haris Tabakovic, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes comes forward to gather the ball.

32' Damion Downs (Hamburger) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
31' Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Robert Schroder blows his whistle for a foul.
30' 6:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
27' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hamburger SV.
26' Bakery Jatta (Hamburger) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

25' A nice pass finds Nicolai Remberg (Hamburger) in space. He sets himself up and hammers in a fantastic shot from distance that looks bound for the bottom right corner, but Moritz Nicolas pulls off a breathtaking save to deny him.
23' Some great controlled play and passing from B. Monchengladbach. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
20' Robert Schroder has a clear sight and sees a foul from Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach).

19' A neat pass is well received by Damion Downs (Hamburger), who is lurking on the edge of the box and produces a low drive directed towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
17' Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) takes the direct free kick from far out, but his shot flies into the stands. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.

16' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Robert Schroder blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Hamburger SV, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
15' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Miro Muheim (Hamburger).
14' Jordan Torunarigha (Hamburger) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
13' Great save! Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Moritz Nicolas.

9' A precise low pass is received by Miro Muheim (Hamburger), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
8' Hamburger SV seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

5' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by Moritz Nicolas, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
3' A crossfield pass from Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hamburger SV.
2' Robert Schroder blows his whistle. Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) commits a foul after dangerous play.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. B. Monchengladbach will have the kick-off.
Robert Schroder got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
